periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Drafted a family prevention guide with parent focus groups in Riverside and East Flats. Started a teen version with student reviewers. Partners: Harborview Unified School District, Harborview Community Health Center.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Finalize the guide and pilot it in pediatric offices.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Finalized the family guide and piloted it in pediatric offices. Translated it into two more languages and scripted a parent video on vaping. Partners: Harborview Community Health Center, Harborview Unified School District, Parks/Rec/Libraries.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Print 6,000 guides in three languages for back-to-school nights and libraries, and post the parent video on vaping.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Printed 6,000 family guides in three languages and distributed them at back-to-school nights, pediatric offices and library branches. A short video for parents on talking about vaping was posted to the district site. Partners: Harborview Unified School District, Harborview Community Health Center, Parks/Rec/Libraries.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Add a text-message series of weekly conversation prompts for parents and refresh the teen version using student feedback.
